title: material.gpu_cpu_divergence_detected
description: M15B § GPU vs CPU divergence detector — fires at the first divergent tick when the GPU material kernel and the CPU truth fallback disagree on the per-tick blake3 sim_checksum. Reason vocabulary: byte_mismatch (same tick, different bytes; canonical case), tick_skew (lockstep broke), length_mismatch (one trace ended early). Producer: cf-physics::determinism::DivergenceDetector pushed by the engine after both kernels emit their per-tick checksum samples. Engine pauses + dumps both states on fire per spec § acceptance scenario 7. Additive-only per M4 DR-002.
